reviews.text: I've been getting my hair colored, highlighted, and cut by Rico for a while now. He takes his time to do a thorough consultation before beginning to ensure my hair turns out great. I always leave the salon happy and more confident when Rico does my hair - plus he's the sweetest guy! Definitely recommend this salon.

The Conte Salon mirrors the finest Madison Avenue salon. Polina is a superb colorist and stylist. She went above and beyond my expectations. I love my hair! Thank you Polina. I will highly recommend the salon and Polina to my friends and family.
Kathia did my color and extensions. She is the best. The color looks beautiful. Amazing highlights and depth. The extensions are incredible. I feel great. Highly recommend!!!
